source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Hole order worked out from the photos and the card's pars and lengths (the course is a tight layout where several fairways carry holes both ways); it fits the card well but is not confirmed by a course map.
unsure.1: Tee not clearly seen; the hole is placed from the clubhouse tees west then north up the long west fairway to the green north of it.
unsure.10: Tee placed at the tee pads south of the fairway near the clubhouse; card says par 5 but the corridor is about 420 yd.
unsure.11: Shares a fairway with 12 going the other way; tee placed at the south end of that fairway.
unsure.17: Shares the fairway west of the big lake with 18 going the other way; tee placed at the tee strip by the clubhouse.
unsure.18: Tee placed at the north end of the fairway east of the big lake; this hole and 17 are the least certain.
